scene.ko: 허리 통증으로 처방받은 진통제를 받으며 부작용을 묻다가, 먹고 있는 감기약과 성분이 겹친다는 말을 듣고 대신 먹을 감기약을 고른다.

lines.en: Here's the pain reliever your doctor prescribed for your back. Have you taken it before?
lines.ko: 의사 선생님이 허리 때문에 처방해 주신 진통제예요. 전에 드셔 보신 적 있으세요?

lines.en: No, this is my first time. Are there any side effects I should be aware of?
lines.ko: 아니요, 처음이에요. 제가 알아 둬야 할 부작용이 있나요?
alt: No, it's my first time. What side effects should I watch out for?
No, never. Does it have any side effects I should know about?

lines.en: Some people get an upset stomach, so take it with food. It can also make you a little dizzy.
lines.ko: 속이 불편해지는 분들이 있어서 음식과 함께 드세요. 조금 어지러울 수도 있어요.

lines.en: I see. I'm also taking a cold medicine right now. Is it safe to take them together?
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 지금 감기약도 먹고 있는데요. 같이 먹어도 안전한가요?
alt: Okay. I'm taking cold medicine at the moment, too. Can I take both?
Got it. Is it okay to take this with the cold medicine I'm on?

lines.en: Do you happen to have the box with you? I'd like to check the ingredients.
lines.ko: 혹시 상자를 가지고 계세요? 성분을 확인해 보고 싶어서요.

lines.en: Yes, I have it right here in my bag.
Ah, this cold medicine already has ibuprofen in it. Taking it with your prescription could be too hard on your stomach.
lines.ko: 아, 이 감기약에는 이미 이부프로펜이 들어 있네요. 처방약이랑 같이 드시면 위에 너무 무리가 갈 수 있어요.

lines.en: Oh, I had no idea. What would you suggest I take for my cold instead?
lines.ko: 아, 전혀 몰랐어요. 그럼 감기에는 대신 뭘 먹는 게 좋을까요?
alt: Oh, I didn't know that. What should I take for my cold instead?
I had no idea. Is there a different cold medicine I can take?

lines.en: This one has no pain relievers in it, so it's safe to take with your prescription. Just avoid alcohol while you're on these.
lines.ko: 이건 진통 성분이 없어서 처방약이랑 같이 드셔도 괜찮아요. 다만 약 드시는 동안 술은 피하세요.

lines.en: Thank you for catching that. I'm glad I asked.
lines.ko: 놓치지 않고 알려 주셔서 고마워요. 물어보길 잘했네요.
alt: Thanks for noticing that. Good thing I asked.
I'm glad I asked. Thank you for checking.

expressions.en: Are there any side effects I should be aware of?
expressions.ko: 제가 알아 둬야 할 부작용이 있나요?

expressions.en: Is it safe to take ___ together?
expressions.note: 약을 함께 먹어도 되는지 물을 때
